title: US DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says recent tech outages are not tied to cyberattacks but to "pushing new technology on top of really old computer systems" (David Shepardson/Reuters)
summary: David Shepardson / Reuters: US DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says recent tech outages are not tied to cyberattacks but to “pushing new technology on top of really old computer systems” — The top US homeland security official said Tuesday a series of technology outages are not tied to cyberattacks …
